title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - User Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
description: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.
